chosen_titles.rationale: Title 42 (Public Officers and Agencies) houses RCW 42.17A (Disclosure — Campaign Finance, Lobbying, Records), Washington's unified lobbying-disclosure statute including lobbyist registration and expenditure reporting.

notes: WA reorganized its public-disclosure regime in 2011 (Ch. 60, Laws of 2011) consolidating former RCW 42.17 into RCW 42.17A, a single combined campaign-finance + lobbying disclosure chapter under Title 42. No parallel lobbying regime in Title 44 (Legislative) or elsewhere — Title 42 is the sole entry point.
